description: LiNaY₂F₈ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.56 Å. Li is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing LiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.93 Å) and four longer (2.26 Å) Li-F bond lengths. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.47 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two equivalent Y atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na, one Li, and two equivalent Y atoms to form distorted FNaLiY₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent FNaLiY₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FLi₂Y₂ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent FNaLiY₂ trigonal pyramids. In the third F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Li and two equivalent Y atoms to form distorted FLi₂Y₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent FNaLiY₂ trigonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent FNaLiY₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Y atoms.
